# TASK-166 — specification

## Scope

One idea in, draft out: the "What are you building?" sentence becomes the description and, when an AI is available and allowed for the project, queues one run that drafts only the essential answers as proposals (unknown where the sentence says nothing). Without an AI it says so. Nothing is written directly.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] The idea is the "What are you building?" sentence.
- [x] It becomes the description, and one AI run (through the same checks as any run: feature switch, local-only rule, budgets, provider) drafts only the essential answers as a proposal, with "unknown" where the sentence says nothing.
- [x] A refusal comes back as an answer with its reason, never as a failure, and nothing is written directly.
